description.value: A longitudinal study examined MBSR-related changes in emotional reactivity and regulation of negative self-beliefs in patients with social anxiety disorder using fMRI and clinical measures.

value: We expected MBSR-related changes in relation to the breath-focused mindful attention, including (a) decreased negative emotion after implementing breath-focused attention, (b) decreased brain activity in emotion-related limbic activity (i.e., amygdala), and (c) increased activity in attention-related brain regions, but (d) no change related to distraction-based attention.

spatial smoothing with a 4-mm 3 isotropic Gaussian kernel

description.value: BOLD fMRI data were preprocessed and analyzed with AFNI version 2008_07_18_1710. The first 6 seconds were eliminated, volumes were registered and realigned, motion parameters were calculated, low-frequency oscillations were removed with a 0.011-Hz high-pass filter, and BOLD signal was converted to percentage signal deviation from the mean per voxel. Data were spatially smoothed with a 4-mm isotropic Gaussian kernel, resampled to isotropic voxels, and transformed to Talairach space for subsequent statistical analysis.
